The sender thanks Masani for the meeting resolutions and says that an initiative to resolve the situation through discussion has been accepted by all parties.\n\nThe message then addresses a Constitution Bill concerning integration, suggesting that it receive silent support without speeches. It notes that Kalahandi also wants to speak in support of preventing disintegration. The telegram closes with the sender's statement that he is disinclined to join a marchpast and asks Masani to wire his reaction.
